How it works
About These Tools
This is a small registry of single-file tools. Every tool runs on your device.
- An agent.py is one Python file a Brainstem loads from its agents/ folder. The model calls it when your request needs it.
- A rapplication is a packaged Brainstem app: one or more agents that work together and install the same way.
- To install a Brainstem tool, run its install command. It saves one file into your Brainstem's agents/ folder. No restart needed.
- To remove a tool, delete its file.
- Browser tools are single HTML files that keep their data in your browser.
Tool Development
Need a custom tool for your workflow? Tools here come in two shapes. A Brainstem tool is one agent.py file, or a rapplication of a few, that a Brainstem loads from its agents/ folder. Their source is in docs/experimental/ in the repository, and tools.json lists them. A browser tool is one HTML file. Its source is in the tools/ folder.
Creating Your Own Tools
A Brainstem tool:
- One Python file whose name ends in _agent.py
- Metadata that tells the model what it does, and a perform method that does it
- Keeps its data in local files on your device
- Install it by saving the file into agents/; remove it by deleting the file
A browser tool:
- One HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inside
- Keeps its data in your browser's local storage
- Export and import, so your data can move with you
- Works on phones and desktops
